filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.point: PJM files in answer to FERC's preliminary finding that its tariff lacks operating requirements for large loads.
filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.quote: that PJM’s Tariff appears to be unjust and unreasonable because it lacks provisions addressing ongoing operational requirements for transmission customers taking transmission service on behalf of large loads.

filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.point: The requirements apply to Large Computational Loads, a subset of Large Loads PJM sees as riskier to the grid.
filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.quote: defining Large Computational Loads, a subset of Large Loads that may pose heightened operational risks in the PJM Region

filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.point: The tariff sets the framework; detailed ride-through and other standards go in PJM's manuals.
filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.quote: which establishes the necessary groundwork for more detailed ride-through standards to be promulgated through revisions to PJM’s Manuals

filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.point: PJM cites a July 22, 2026 event in which about 3.9 GW of large load dropped off the system.
filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.quote: on July 22, 2026, an approximately 3.9 GW large load event caused frequency in the Eastern Interconnection to reach 60.092 Hz

filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.point: PJM says it already has about 10 GW of computational load.
filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.quote: PJM already has approximately 10 GW of computational load in its footprint

filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.point: PJM asks for a January 16, 2027 effective date, earlier than its main large-load filing.
filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.quote: effective January 16, 2027, which is 61 days after the date of this filing

filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.point: PJM consents to FERC severing the ride-through requirements so they can take effect first.
filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.quote: PJM consents to severance of the ride-through requirements from Tariff revisions proposed herein that pertain to other operational requirements

filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.point: PJM would post an annual report on demand for and use of the new transmission services, as the co-location order directed.
filing-er27-522-pjm-ride-through.quote: PJM proposes to post on its website a report containing information about the demand for and use of

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: PJM says this filing and its same-day companions answer the show cause order in full, and asks FERC to close the section 206 proceeding.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: PJM has responded fully to the Large Load Show Cause Order and requests that the FPA section 206 aspect of the order be closed

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: Generator interconnection requests and large-load service requests would be studied together in one 12-month process.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: which will study together New Service Requests, including Generation Interconnection Requests, and requests from Eligible Customers seeking transmission service on behalf of Eligible Load

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: PJM says the new process should take half the time of today's cycle process.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: The process will take half the time of the Cycle process.

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: The first Fast Energization submission window would not open until late November 2027.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: the Submission Window for the first Cycle under the Fast Energization Process would open in late November 2027

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: PJM says full acceptance within ten months is likely needed to use the process for Cycle 02.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: The Commission’s full acceptance of this filing within 10 months of the date it is filed would likely be necessary to facilitate implementation in time for Cycle 02.

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: New services, NITS changes and Eligible Load changes would take effect March 16, 2027; the Fast Energization provisions on an indefinite date.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: PJM therefore seeks an effective date of March 16, 2027, for certain Tariff revisions in Part VIII relating to Eligible Loads and for the revisions in Part III and the new Part XI

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: PJM withdrew its August 17 co-location compliance filing the same day and refiles revised versions here.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: Earlier today, PJM filed a motion to withdraw the August 17 Filing in Docket No. ER26-1479-002 so that it could file replacement revisions in this filing.

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: Customers with retail behind-the-meter generation could net no more than 50 MW of it from their load, as the co-location order directed.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: PJM is proposing revisions to Part III, section 34.2 and Schedule 8 of the RAA to implement the 50 MW netting limit.

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: Interim NITS would let large and co-located loads use spare capacity on an interruptible basis.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: Interim NITS is a transmission service that allows Eligible Customers serving Eligible Load or Large Load to utilize head room on the system as-available on an interruptible basis

filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.point: PJM's transmission owners file cost allocation, the cost recovery framework and rates for the new services separately.
filing-er27-531-pjm-large-loads.quote: The PJM Transmission Owners (“Transmission Owners”) are separately filing revisions to Tariff, Parts VIII, IX, and XI
